title: Mrs. California
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight champions health benefits by standing and opening a gym in the office building, while Jim playfully challenges him. Robert introduces his wife Susan (Mrs. California) to the office, prompting Andy to find her a role despite staffing challenges. Susan faces subtle isolation and discomfort at work, leading to tension among coworkers and with Robert. Meanwhile, Dwight pushes Darryl to take fitness seriously, and Jim expresses mixed feelings about working alongside his wife. The episode explores office dynamics, health initiatives, and the complexities of personal relationships intersecting with work.
